versions.content: Service Name Nm_DisableCommunication Syntax Std_ReturnType Nm_DisableCommunication ( NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle ) Service ID [hex] 0x04 Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Non-reentrant for the same NetworkHandle, reentrant otherwise Parameters (in) NetworkHandle Identification of the NM-channel Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: No error E_NOT_OK: Disabling of NM PDU transmission ability has failed. NetworkHandle does not exist (development only) Module not yet initialized (development only) Description Disables the NM PDU transmission ability. For that purpose <BusNm>_DisableCommunication shall be called in case NmBusType is not set to NM_BUSNM_LOCALNM (e.g. CanNm_Disable Communication function is called if channel is configured as CAN). Available via Nm.h
